contexts.text: The sons of Ham = the derivations of doctrinal things and worships from corrupt internal worship.
These are the nativities of Shem = the derivations of the second Ancient Church. Nativities = the origin and derivation of doctrinal things and worships.
Begat Shelah = derivation thence.
From the Ancient Church, the signification of a horse... was derived to the wise round about, also into Greece.
In multiplying I will multiply = the derivations of truth from affection.
Represented the celestial and spiritual things flowing forth and derived thence in order.
The derivations thence as from their root, or as from their seed, derive their form...
The derivations from the first lot. Signified.
By these are signified the states and derivations of the Lord's Spiritual Church.

Hence, now, are the derivations; namely, the derivations of good and the derivations of truth; the derivations of good in the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, which are represented by the sons of Jokshan; and the derivations of truth there, which are represented by the sons of Midian.
Derivations from the third lot. Signified.
Sons = the derivations thence.
The derivations of the Spiritual Church represented by Ishmael. Signified.
Nativities = the derivations of faith, thus of the Church. References. AC 3267.
The interior qualities according to the derivations of faith. Signified.
These varieties are the derivations which are signified by nativities.
Nativities = derivations; namely, the derivations of faith when faith is treated of, and the derivations of the Church when the Church is treated of.
This is derived into the children...
The things beneath are nothing but derivations and compositions thence.
This good... again produces good; and, through this good, truths again, which are derivations.
When good flows in, they derive it into themselves, and into their own proprium...

In what follows, the Lord's Divine natural good is treated of, but its derivations are described by names... because the derivations of this good exceed the understanding of any man or Angel... But still, when this chapter is read, the derivations which are contained in the names, are represented to the Angels in a general way...
The first derivations thence... and the second. Signified.
Derivations in Divine natural good. Signified.
The quality of the derivations. Signified.
The first derivation of good. Signified.
The third derivation. Signified.
In the vine three shoots = the derivations thence even to the ultimate one... Shoots = derivations; for as the vine = the Intellectual, the shoots are nothing but the derivations thence. AC 5122.
The interiors of man are distinct according to degrees by means of derivations.
The establishment of the Church as to the Intellectual and the derivatives thereof. Signified.
The tertian sons = the derivatives; for as sons and son's sons descend from a parent, they = the derivatives of that thing which is represented by the parent.
And as to the Voluntary and its derivatives. Signified.

The derivatives of the Voluntary of the Church, which are signified by the sons of Machir, are goods conjoined with truths, thus also truths from good; for the truths which are derived from good are the forms of good.
To be produced = further derivation; for when the Church has been established with a man, good continually grows and is derived, both in the internal and also towards the external, and therein.
To become numerous = further derivation, thus continual increase of truth.

Order has been so instituted, that the First being may be in the things derived mediately and immediately... Divine truth itself is the only substantial thing; the things derived are nothing but successive forms thence.
The first class of the derivations of good and truth thence. Signified.
The second class of the derivations of good and truth thence. Signified.
The third class of the derivations of good and truth. Signified.
The conjunction of derived good with related truth. Signified.
A successive derivation from the second class, which is good and thence truth. Signified.
A second successive derivation from the same class, as to good in truth. Signified.
The derivations of faith and charity, their quality. Signified.
A repeated derivation from the second class. Signified.
Derivation (from the conjunction of good and truth in these doctrinal things). Signified.
Truth is falsified, when it is said that the Lord derived all sins into Himself...
They are in the love of the world, who desire to derive into themselves the goods of others.
There are such productions and derivations of truth with those who are of the Spiritual Church. Representation.

All the evil which by means of habit has taken on nature, is derived into the offspring... The derivation of evil from this source at last becomes so great, that everything of man's proper life is nothing but evil. This derived Continuous is not broken and altered, except by means of a life of faith and charity from the Lord. NJHD 175.
The derivations and thence the successions in general, as to their quality, may be presented to the idea by means of fruits. Explained.
To derive also to others. Signified.
Sons and daughters = the truths and goods derived thence.
Nativities = derivations.
Insult by the affection of evil against the truths and goods of faith derived from interior things. Signified.
The reason they are truths and goods derived from interior things, is that interior things are as parents, from which goods and truths are born as sons and daughters.
This is the derivation of this word. AC 9303.
Goods and truths and their derivations. Signified.

Good is that from which are truths, and truths from good are the things from which are scientifics; thus is derived and produced the one from the other; but still good is in all the things produced and derived, because they are from good.
Hence it may be evident, how the one is produced and derived from the other, and that the first is everything in the things produced and derived...
What is inmost in the Heavens inflows into the Heavens which are below, and produces and derives them... That which is inmost is the only thing which essentially lives in the things derived.
From peace by derivation the Angels have all blessedness...
Self-love abstracts all delight from others, and derives it into itself... HH 400:4.
He wants to derive into himself the goods of all others...
As from a plane of derivation...
Under Desire, see this reference.
From these two are ultimately derived sensations...
Affections are derivations from the love of each person.
The derivations which are the affections of this love, are as many as are the evils into which it determines itself.

The love of each person cannot exist without derivations, which are called affections; the derivations of infernal love are affections of evil and falsity, properly concupiscences; and the derivations of heavenly love are affections of good and truth, properly dilections.
The concupiscences of evil, which are derivations of it, have life in them from it.
The derivations of love are called affections... CL 197. ISB 8:4.
In derivation it is called delight... and in the universal sense, Good.
Wherever they go they derive to themselves the delights of others.
They who are in self-love deprive all others of their delight, and derive it into themselves.
The singles by derivation from principles make one.
In universal nature there are perpetual compositions and derivations...
The derivations were similar, as it were of children...
The examination of derivation as of families...

The organs (of sense and motion) are derivations thence, just as streams are from their springs, or as principiates from their principles, or as substantiates from their substances; and these derivations are of such a nature, that the brains are present everywhere...
They are the derivations and productions of the uses before mentioned...
